sentence_rules: Person: write 'we' and 'you,' not 'Disruption Now provides.'
Verbs over nouns: show people doing the work; active voice by default.
One idea per sentence: if a sentence holds two ideas, make it two sentences.
Lead with the point, then the detail.
Plain American English: no insider word without a plain explanation next to it.
Numbers earn trust: use the real figure over 'many' or 'lots.'
Verify the number first: check any stat against the authoritative source before it goes out.

punctuation.em_dashes: NONE. Zero em dashes in any copy, titles included. The em dash is the clearest AI tell. Use a period, comma, colon, or parentheses instead.
punctuation.en_dash_and_hyphen: En dash in number ranges (10-20) and hyphen in compound words (real-time) are fine.
punctuation.colon_semicolon: A colon introduces a genuine list, used sparingly. Do not bolt an explanation on with a colon. Use semicolons sparingly.
punctuation.no_spatial_metaphors: No 'tables / rooms / in the same place' metaphors. Name the literal action.
